answers.question: If my CGPA slips below the minimum, what academic status am I put on, and what is the limit?
answers.answer: If your CGPA slips below the minimum, you will be put on academic warning. The limit is 3 consecutive semesters below 2.00, after which the admission will be automatically closed.
